## Purpose

Explain how a synthetic system review interacts with a synthetic billing withhold.

## The rule

A synthetic system review runs on a recurring cycle of 30 days [@CL-CMP-0001]. When a synthetic deficiency remains open, the synthetic billing withhold rate is 5 percent [@CL-CMP-0002].

## How it works

Synthetic reviewers check control operation and record open items before billing runs.

## Worked example

Synthetic example. The numbers are made up.

On a synthetic invoice of 100,000 USD, a 5 percent withhold retains 5,000 USD until the review closes.

## Never confuse

Do not confuse a synthetic system review or a synthetic billing withhold with a final contract closeout audit.

## Company calibration

Confirm the approving role and escalation path [@Q-001; @XC-01].
